Implement Link Markdown Steps To Code Through Realizations (.sessions/_backlog/link-markdown-steps-to-code-through-realizations.md on main; copy it to this branch's backlog if missing). The person's direction, 2026-11-23: a scenario's realization links markdown to markdown, just as a code step links to code. Each operation a realization's call graph names is matched to that operation in the accompanying markdown domain model (DDD model, domain-model.md) or class model (Clean Engineering model markdown), and the markdown step gets the same invokes / invokedBy edges to those model operations that a story test's step gets to code, matched through the step's domain-term links (++Ticket++ -> domain-model.md#ticket). A renamed operation or a step with no realization leaves the step unlinked, never wrongly linked. Then let code-steps-invoke-code (or a sibling rule) ask the same of markdown Whens that have a realization, so a When whose realization names no model operation is reported. Today the scenario file parser only reads the realization fence (cdd_guidance/practices/stories/model/markdown/scenario_file.py, scenario_parts.py) and nothing records the step's operations. Name the flow per boundary first (TDD supplement), test on the graph, add the story to the story map and thin slice on main, and move the backlog item to .sessions/_complete on main when done.
